View 360 Observability Dashboard
This dashboard provides a consolidated view of the operational health, security posture, and cost of all monitored cloud systems. Data is collected automatically from each system's AWS environment every 5 minutes for real-time metrics and daily for security compliance, resource inventory, and cost analysis.
The Health Score for each system is calculated from alarm status, security findings, resource availability, and performance metrics. Use the system tabs (System A, System B) to drill into a specific system's detailed view including active alarms, security findings, resource breakdown, and cost trends. The Security and Resilience tabs provide a cross-system aggregate view for governance and audit purposes.

CalculatedFields.Name: alert_line_1
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/* Critical Alarms tile: real critical operational signal. alarm_critical = number of CloudWatch alarms currently in ALARM state (NOT a severity split - CloudWatch alarms have no native severity). Also flags CRITICAL security findings. '🟢 Clear' when nothing is firing. See docs/quicksight/health-scoring.md */
ifelse({alarm_critical} > 0, concat("🔴 ", toString({alarm_critical}), " CRIT"), {security_findings_critical} > 0, concat("🔴 ", toString({security_findings_critical}), " CRIT"), "🟢 Clear")

CalculatedFields.Name: alert_line_2
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/* Warnings tile: the highest-priority NON-critical attention item. Priority order: HIGH findings, then MEDIUM findings, then alarms in INSUFFICIENT_DATA state (a monitoring-coverage gap, shown as 'NO DATA' - real, but not a failure). '-' when nothing needs attention. Note alarm_warning counts INSUFFICIENT_DATA alarms; alarm_critical (Critical Alarms tile) counts alarms in ALARM state. See docs/quicksight/health-scoring.md */
ifelse({security_findings_high} > 0, concat("🟡 ", toString({security_findings_high}), " HIGH"), {security_findings_medium} > 0, concat("🟡 ", toString({security_findings_medium}), " MED"), {alarm_warning} > 0, concat("🟡 ", toString({alarm_warning}), " NO DATA"), "-")

CalculatedFields.Name: health_score_label
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/* Plain-language status word matching the health-score bands: Healthy(>=90)/Degraded(70-89)/Unhealthy(<70). Replaces the old "passing/total" count, which mixed resource inventory into a health label. Edit the band cut-offs to match your KPI colours; see docs/quicksight/health-scoring.md */
ifelse({health_percentage} >= 90, "Healthy", {health_percentage} >= 70, "Degraded", "Unhealthy")

CalculatedFields.Name: health_status_icon
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/* 5-dot health indicator. Breakpoints align with the Healthy(>=90)/Degraded(70-89)/Unhealthy(<70) status bands used by the KPI colour and health_score_label. Edit these numbers to re-tune the dots; see docs/quicksight/health-scoring.md */
ifelse({health_percentage} >= 90, "●●●●●", {health_percentage} >= 75, "●●●●○", {health_percentage} >= 60, "●●●○○", {health_percentage} >= 40, "●●○○○", "●○○○○")

CalculatedFields.Name: service_availability
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
(AI generated) service_availability_status = ifelse(
    canary_passing = canary_total, "🟢 " + toString(canary_passing) + "/" + toString(canary_total) + " UP",
    canary_passing > 0, "🟡 " + toString(canary_passing) + "/" + toString(canary_total) + " DEGRADED",
    "🔴 0/" + toString(canary_t
*/
ifelse({canary_passing} = {canary_total}, concat("🟢 ", toString({canary_passing}), "/", toString({canary_total}), " UP"), {canary_passing} > 0, concat("🟡 ", toString({canary_passing}), "/", toString({canary_total}), " DEGRADED"), concat("🔴 0/", toString({canary_total})))

CalculatedFields.Name: calc_severity
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
(AI generated) use teh severity feild and set teh follwoing Critical = 1, High = 2, medium =  3, Low = 4
*/
switch(severity, 'CRITICAL', 1, 'HIGH', 2, 'MEDIUM', 3, 'LOW', 4, 0)

CalculatedFields.Name: calc_compliance_score
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
(AI generated) sum compliant_rules / sum total_rules
*/
sum({compliant_rules}) / sum({total_rules})

CalculatedFields.Name: calc_ping_status
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
(AI generated) if ping_Status == null or offline return offline else return ping_status
*/
ifelse(isNull({ping_status}) OR {ping_status}='offline', 'OFFLINE', toUpper({ping_status}))

CalculatedFields.Name: calc_severity
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
(AI generated) ifelse(isNotNull(severity), toUpper(severity), null)  if null, return NONE
*/
ifelse(isNotNull(severity), toUpper(severity), 'NONE')

CalculatedFields.Name: calc_state
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
(AI generated) ifelse(isNotNull(state), toUpper(state), null) if Null return NOT INSTALLED
*/
coalesce(ifelse(isNotNull(state), toUpper(state), null), 'NOT INSTALLED')

CalculatedFields.Name: calc_rotation_enabled
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
(AI generated) if rotation_enabled equals to null or less than equlas to 0 then return 0 els ereturn the rotation enabled
*/
ifelse(isNull({rotation_enabled}) OR {rotation_enabled} <= 0, 0, {rotation_enabled})

CalculatedFields.Name: calc_availability_zone
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
(AI generated) ifelse(contains({availability_zone}, ','), substring({availability_zone}, 1, locate({availability_zone}, ',') - 1), {availability_zone})  if null return AZ Agnostic
*/
ifelse(isNull({availability_zone}), 'AZ Agnostic', ifelse(contains({availability_zone}, ','), substring({availability_zone}, 1, locate({availability_zone}, ',') - 1), {availability_zone}))

CalculatedFields.Name: calc_action
CalculatedFields.Expression: ifelse(contains(toLower(action), "block"), "BLOCK", contains(toLower(action), "count"), "COUNT", contains(toLower(action), "allow"), "ALLOW", contains(toLower(action), "none"), "NONE", contains(toLower(action), "captcha"), "CAPTCHA", contains(toLower(action), "challenge"), "CHALLENGE","OTHER")
